name: Superspy Steve
source: You play as Steve, of the aforementioned super spy Steve, and you just inherited a car dealership along with a massive amount of debts. Your days of training hard and playing even harder are complicated by this new problem in your life, and so no jet-setting for you until you can get those debts paid off. However, being locked down for a bit might be worth your time with your schedule opening up for a little dating action while you get your grind on. It's time to put your swagger on and see if you have what it takes to achieve success with the ladies. Honing your skillset to get the ladies in bed would be a valuable asset to your spy résumé.
translation: 你就是標題裡的超級間諜史蒂夫。你剛繼承了一家汽車經銷店，還有隨店附贈的一屁股債。你原來訓練時拼命，玩起來更拼命，如今生活裡多了這麼個難題，想坐飛機滿世界跑？先把債還清再說。不過，暫時待在一個地方也許值了。忙著賺錢之餘，總算也能排出時間約會。拿出你的派頭，看看你能不能討得女士們的歡心吧。要是能練就一身讓佳人願意與你共赴雲雨的本領，在間諜履歷上也能添個亮點。
